name: ASM-008 parallel gripper assembly benchmark
description: Intermediate hierarchical CAD assembly benchmark for a two-finger robotic parallel gripper with palm, mirrored fingers, pivots, links, pads, and actuator cylinder.

tasks.prompt: Create a two-finger robotic parallel gripper assembly with palm/base, mirrored left and right fingers, pivot pins, link bars, grip pads, and a simple actuator cylinder. Keep repeated pins and links functional.
assumptions: Intermediate assembly benchmark intended to exercise hierarchy, named modules, and repeated functional components without BRIEF-001 full-vehicle complexity.
Robust simple boxes, cylinders, and compounds are preferred over fragile booleans or detailed decorative hardware.
Generated STEP, GLB, topology, and component artifacts are produced by the CAD pipeline and are not hand-edited source of truth.
